answer: Simultaneous liveness draws. At dawn of each epoch a public random beacon picks 10% of identities and gives each a fresh task due inside the same 90-second window. A key that misses forfeits a 5,000 POA bond, and a hollow key with no agent behind it cannot answer. An operator running 400 keys draws about 40 at once, so it needs 40x the live compute in that window, and 40 answers from one model in 90 seconds tend to match, which graders flag. Honest agents pay one quick answer per draw.
